[[File:Taylor Swift at the 2023 MTV Video Music Awards (1).png|thumb|upright|American singer-songwriter [[Taylor Swift]] is the most-streamed artist in Spotify's history.]]

The following list contains the most-streamed artists on the [[Streaming media|audio streaming]] platform [[Spotify]]. As of April 2026, [[Taylor Swift]] is the most-streamed artist in Spotify's history. [[Bad Bunny]] is the most-streamed male artist.<ref name="Millman-2026">{{Cite magazine |last=Millman |first=Ethan |date=April 23, 2026 |title=Taylor Swift, Bad Bunny, The Weeknd Top Spotify's All-Time Chart Lists |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/music/music-news/taylor-swift-tops-spotify-all-time-artist-chart-1236572384/ |access-date=April 23, 2026 |magazine=[[The Hollywood Reporter]] |archive-date=April 23, 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260423124850/https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/music/music-news/taylor-swift-tops-spotify-all-time-artist-chart-1236572384/ |url-status=live}}</ref> 

Since 2013, Spotify has published a yearly list of its most-streamed artists, which has been topped by Bad Bunny a record four times (2020–2022; 2025), being the only artist to do so in three consecutive years. [[Drake (musician)|Drake]] has topped the list three times (2015–2016; 2018), while Swift is the only female artist to have topped the list (2023–2024).

==Most monthly listeners==
[[File:BrunoMars24KMagicWorldTourLive (cropped).jpg|thumb|upright|American singer-songwriter [[Bruno Mars]] is currently the artist with the most monthly listeners on Spotify]] 
As of {{CURRENTMONTHNAME}} {{CURRENTYEAR}}, American singer-songwriter [[Bruno Mars]] is the artist with the most monthly listeners. Canadian singer-songwriter [[The Weeknd]] was the first artist to surpass 100 million monthly listeners, while American singer-songwriter [[Taylor Swift]] was the first female artist and second overall.<ref>{{cite magazine|last=Franklin|first=McKinley|url=https://variety.com/2023/music/news/taylor-swift-spotify-record-monthly-listeners-1235707101/|title=Taylor Swift Becomes First Female ==Most-followed artists==
<!-- Do not insert flags for artists in this list, per MOS:WORDPRECEDENCE -->
[[File:Arijit Singh performance at MMRDA ground Mumbai in 2018.jpg|thumb|upright=0.8|Indian playback singer [[Arijit Singh]] is the most-followed artist on Spotify.]]
